title: Topographic Rossby Waves and Inertial-Wave Coexistence
exact_target: Explain whether the topographic-Rossby expansion breaks down locally or describes waves coexisting with the exact inertial waves.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000578 (OWR-1325-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Theory and Modelling in Atmosphere-Ocean Science (2006), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2006/39, pp. 2307--2398; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 75.

status_qualification: The basin geometry, boundary slope, and asymptotic expansion of the contribution are part of the context. The source does not ask whether every Rossby wave in every geometry diverges; the two alternatives concern the particular paradox described there.
